node_id.description: The node this record belongs to, as contracts/node-identity.schema.json names it. Required so a record read on its own says which node it is from; a console that holds a peer's records through a crossing must never present them as its own (decisions/0039). Added 2026-08-25: the record carried this field and the schema did not, so contract.foreign_records could not see a foreign one at all and additionalProperties:false would have rejected the honest projection.

principal_id.description: Durable principal this session claims to speak as when the binding can resolve one. Null means the binding did not establish a principal. This is identity provenance only: it grants no authority and does not replace operator_id or session_id.

binding_id.description: The Human Binding or Model Binding through which this operator reaches the console; a binding realizes an interface and grants no authority.

unread_cursor.description: Opaque read-position marker for this operator; it conditions presentation only and is never an authority or standing input.
